title: Model access
access.label: Which access should sessions use?
access.auto.hint: Your subscription, else your API key, else the DFX platform.
platform-note: The DFX platform access is available only on DFX execution devices. On your own devices, sessions need your subscription or API key.
model.label: Model
model.none: The hub offers no model choice for this access; the default is used.
fallback.label: When a subscription is used up
fallback.own: Use DFX access when my own subscription is used up
fallback.own.hint: Charged by use to the organization's credit. Off: the task waits until your subscription is free again and asks you in the situation view.
fallback.platform: Use DFX access over OpenRouter when the operator's subscriptions are used up
fallback.platform.hint: Both are DFX access and charged. Off: the task waits for the next free operator subscription.
saved: Saved. New sessions use this setting.
quotas.title: Quotas
quotas.load-failed: The quotas could not be loaded: {reason}
quotas.unavailable: Quotas are not available (no subscription connected, or the subscription does not report them).
usage.label: Usage of this task
quotas.unreadable: Quotas cannot be read: the connected access (for example a long-lived token from “claude setup-token”) does not allow reading them. Sessions still run.
org.title: Model access and quotas
org.intro: The model accesses the sessions of this organization can use, with their quotas as far as they can be read.
org.load-failed: The model access could not be loaded: {reason}
org.summary.release: Subscriptions: {usable} available · {exhausted} used up – next release {time}
org.own.none: No own subscription connected, or it reports no quotas.
org.own.unreadable: Not readable: the connected access does not allow reading the quotas.
org.operator.not-granted: This organization does not use the operator's subscriptions.
org.platform.unavailable: DFX access over OpenRouter: not available right now
switch.cause.unusable: former access could not be used
consent.hint: DFX access is charged by use to the organization's credit. Without an answer the task continues by itself on your subscription once it is free again.
consent.always.hint: “Always” holds for all your tasks; you can switch it off in the settings under “Model access”.
consent.always.saved: Saved: when your own subscription is used up, your tasks continue with DFX access.
